quality_assessment: Excellent chapter with comprehensive coverage of performance features. Minor issues are mostly missing implementation details that would help users fine-tune performance.

issues.description: Chapter mentions DFA size limit but doesn't specify the actual default value
issues.fix_suggestion: Add the specific default value to help users understand when they might need to adjust it

issues.description: macOS-specific memory mapping behavior not documented
issues.should_add: Note that memory mapping is disabled by default on macOS due to performance overhead, but can be enabled with --mmap if beneficial for your use case.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add platform-specific note in the Memory Mapping section explaining macOS default behavior
issues.source_reference: features.json:422-424 - macos: Disabled by default due to overhead

issues.should_add: Ripgrep uses a 64 KB default buffer for reading files. This is automatically managed but understanding the buffer size can help diagnose memory usage.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection on buffer size configuration in the Buffer and Memory Tuning section

issues.description: Lock-free implementation detail could be more explicit
issues.current_content: This lock-free parallel iteration means ripgrep scales well across many cores without contention overhead.
issues.should_be: This lock-free parallel iteration (using atomic operations for work distribution) means ripgrep scales well across many cores without contention overhead.
issues.fix_suggestion: Clarify that the lock-free implementation uses atomic operations for work distribution

issues.description: Chapter mentions regex size limit but doesn't specify the actual default value
issues.current_content: Useful in memory-constrained environments or when dealing with extremely large patterns.
issues.should_be: The default is 100 MB. Useful in memory-constrained environments or when dealing with extremely large patterns.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add the specific default value (100 MB) to help users understand when this limit might be reached

issues.description: Heap limits mentioned but no configuration details provided
issues.current_content: Ripgrep has internal heap limit controls to prevent excessive memory usage. These are automatically managed but can be important when...
issues.should_be: Ripgrep has internal heap limit controls to prevent excessive memory usage. While these are automatically managed, you can configure heap allocation behavior through the --heap-limit flag (if exposed) or by adjusting other memory parameters like --dfa-size-limit.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add information on how heap limits can be influenced, even if indirectly through other flags
issues.source_reference: features.json:420 - heap_allocation: Eager (default), Error(limit) for constraints
